يعتصروا (form VIII)
# يَعْتَصِرُوا (yaʕtaṣirū) /jaʕ.ta.sˤi.ruː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَصَرَ (iʕtaṣara)
# يُعْتَصَرُوا (yuʕtaṣarū) /juʕ.ta.sˤa.ruː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَصَرَ (iʕtaṣara)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
